page_title: National Standard GB28181--Local Web Registration Platform
page_content:
[TOC]



### Prerequisites:
- The device network can access the Internet normally, for example: 4G dial-up is successful or wired network routing is successful or WiFi connection is successful, refer to the article introduction of "Function Usage" >>> "Network Function"!
- The device and computer are in the same LAN segment, and the computer can ping the local IP address of the device

### Operation steps:
1.Open your computer's browser and enter the device's local network IP address or AP hotspot address to access the web login interface. Enter the login password "Adm_123" and click "Login". To view the device's local network IP address, refer to the article "Function Usage" >>> "Network Functions"
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=20bf4f571655954ba109e9b1d3b92ad0)
2.Enter the username and password on the login page to access the settings page. Default username: admin, default password: Adm_123 3. Click on the settings page. Normal Settings >> Network Settings Enter the network settings interface
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=4a2baa06fb272112acf3df53f80019df)
3.On the settings page, click General Settings >> Network Settings to enter the network settings interface.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=c64f9a9f1b8909ea4b642c057300acd4)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=2ab5ef87397933a6d06593244c5113ce)
4.fill in the parameters such as “Open function” “Server IP” “Server port” “Authentication username” “Authentication password” 
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=c73ff6fd7d14895cb3bd8a40f91195c8)
5.Click on the settings page General Settings >> System Information Enter the system information interface
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=2f7bb9698bff4b276ef5357064ff80a8)
6.Enter the device system's WEB interface to check if the connection is successful, or check if the platform is online
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=427e09fa0b2403a310c2096f4aacd252)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=b4084f4f396cf41144778979f1dc1fbd)
